budget_items.topic: Sewer billing rate, minimum charge and wells charge
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Current rate of $12.65 per 100 cu.ft. proposed to rise to $13.66, effective 4/1/22; minimum charge to $115; wells charge from $231.87 to $250.38 (9 wells accounts).
